title: Confession: We LOVE the Prodigal story… until the feast is for someone we don’t like. 😂🍽️
paragraphs:
Confession: We LOVE the Prodigal story… until the feast is for someone we don’t like. 😂🍽️
Plot twist: grace still RSVPs “YES.”
If grace feels unfair… you’re finally getting it.
“But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.” — Luke 15:32 (NIV)
